Haven't you heard what David did when he and his men were hungry? [1]

Is it lawful to do good or do evil? To save a life or destroy it?

6:20-23, Cf. Mt 5:1-12

for the kingdom of God belongs to you.

Blessed are you who weep, for you will laugh.

Jump for joy,

because you'll get a big reward in heaven.

You've had your good times.

6:27-28, Cf. 6, Mt 5:43-47

blocks.html:
Love your enemies.

Do good to those who hate you. [7]

Bless those who curse you,

and pray for those who mistreat you.

blocks.html:
If someone hits you on the cheek, turn the other cheek.

Give to anyone who asks
6:30, Cf. Mt 5:40-42

blocks.html:
Give to anyone who asks.

If you only love those who love you, or do good to those are good to you, why should you be praised?

Even sinners do that.

blocks.html:
Love your enemies.

Do good to them and lend to them, hoping for nothing in return.

You will be rewarded by God, who is kind to ungrateful and evil people.

blocks.html: Be merciful, as God is merciful. [10]

blocks.html:
Don't judge, and you won't be judged. [11]

Don't condemn, and you won't be condemned.

Forgive, and you'll be forgiven.

But everyone who is perfect will be the master.

blocks.html:
Why do you see the speck in another's eye,

but can't see the log in your own eye?

Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

6:43-46, Cf. Mt 7:17-20

Bad people have bad hearts.

People speak from their hearts.

blocks.html:
If you do what I say, you're like a person who build a house on a rock.

When a flood comes, it won't be destroyed.

If you don't do what I say, you're like someone who builds a house on the ground without a foundation.

When a stream comes, it will be destroyed.

Who were the apostles?

Did Jesus preach his first sermon on a mountain or a plain?

Is it good to be wealthy?

Is it good to be happy?

What the Bible says about rich people

Well, it's a nice thought. But it seems strange coming from someone who damns his enemies to hell. (Mark 16:16)

How should enemies be treated?

How should nonbelievers be treated?

Invite someone that has hit you to do it again, and if someone steals from you offer them something additional. Don't turn down any borrowers (Do Christian bankers follow this one?), and when you loan something don't ask for it back.

How should nonbelievers be treated?

Is God merciful?

Judge not. (v.37)

To judge or not to judge?

but she washed my feet with her tears, and then wiped them with her hair.

You didn't anoint my head with oil, but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment.

Why would they do that? Well, the Governing Body doesn't believe in a soul, so they say the good thief died like everyone else. Was the tomb opened or closed?

When did the women discover Jesus's body was missing?

Were the men (or angels) inside or outside?

Were the men or angels sitting or standing?

Whom did the women see?

They ... told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest. (vv.8-9)

Did the women immediately tell the disciples?

It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women. (v.10)

How many women came?

Their eyes were holden that they should not know him (v.16)

Two of Jesus' disciples failed to recognize him after his supposed resurrection. Maybe that was because the person they saw wasn't really Jesus.

To whom did Jesus first appear?

When they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive. (v.23)

Did Mary Magdalene recognize Jesus?

He said unto them, O fools. (v.25)

The man (whoever he was) who talked with the two unnamed apostles on the way to Emmaus calls them fools, thereby making himself a candidate for hellfire. (Matthew 5:22)

Is it OK to call someone a fool?

And he vanished out of their sight. (v.31)

Jesus, the invisible man!

Their eyes were opened, and they knew him ... And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us?" (vv.31-32)

The disciples spent the day talking to the mysterious man before finally recognizing him when "their hearts burned within them."

How many disciples did Jesus appear to in his first post resurrection appearance?

Jesus just appears out of nowhere!
